description: This file defines the 'CollectionEndpoint' interface within the OrangeHRM system, specifying methods related to CRUD operations for resource collections, along with their validation rules and exception handling.

classes.name: CollectionEndpoint
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing resource collections via API, including retrieval, creation, deletion, validation rules, and associated exception handling.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieve a collection of resources; may throw API-related exceptions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provide validation rules for the 'getAll' method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new resource; may throw API-related exceptions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provide validation rules for the 'create' method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete resources; may throw API-related exceptions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provide validation rules for the 'delete' method.
